title: 欧盟外长卡拉斯：加拿大准成员地位，意味着什么？
speaker: Kaja Kallas

segments.en: escalation will only have losers you were in Montreal before you got to Atlanta you were there for a summit with with Canada a European Canadian summit and I wonder if we could have any more color here on what associate membership in the EU looks like for Canada what does that mean in in real terms
segments.zh: 升级只会带来输家。你之前去了蒙特利尔，然后到亚特兰大，参加与加拿大的欧加峰会。我想问，加拿大成为欧盟准成员具体意味着什么？实际影响如何？

segments.en: as we see Canada pursuing a close relationship with Europe well it actually means exactly that that we want to have a deeper relationship with Canada and Canada wants this deeper relationship with
segments.zh: 我们看到加拿大寻求与欧洲建立紧密关系，这实际上意味着我们想与加拿大深化关系，而加拿大也愿意与我们深化关系。

segments.en: us what it means is more people to people contacts we have different programs that we can work together
segments.zh: 这意味着更多民间交流，我们有不同项目可以合作。

segments.en: it means also more security and defense partnership we have already agreement with them and and Canada is participating also in our defense programs we are looking into more trade relations more energy
segments.zh: 还意味着更深入的安全与防务伙伴关系。我们已与加拿大达成协议，加拿大也参与我们的防务项目。我们正寻求更多贸易关系和能源合作。

segments.en: cooperation there is so many things where we are very like minded and see that this relationship benefits the citizens of both EU as well as Canada let me ask you lastly just what this is paving the
segments.zh: 在许多方面我们理念相近，并认为这种关系惠及欧盟和加拿大公民。最后请问，这为……铺平了道路？
